purpose: Teach: 新聞紙/ナルニア/極上/旅立ち/母音/アイデンティティー/灯台/ピンク色

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、新聞紙でゴミ箱作ったろ?
lines.en: You made that trash bin out of newspaper, didn't you?
lines.style: Light, teasing lilt on the opening. Watching for his reaction. Playful certainty—she already knows the answer. Quick pace, warm challenge.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ナルニア国物語の映画好きだろ?桜
lines.en: You love the Narnia movies, don't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Deflecting with a soft counter-question. Slight pause before her name—calling her out for knowing too much. Careful but not defensive. A small smile underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、極上のお米食べてんだろ?
lines.en: Your family eats really nice rice at home, right?
lines.style: Curious observation delivered like she's noticed something small but specific. Warm tone. Not accusatory—just stating what she knows. Slight tilt of interest at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、卒業の旅立ち緊張するな、桜
lines.en: You're nervous about graduation and moving on, aren't you?
lines.style: Softer than before. The teasing drops. Direct eye contact in the voice. Acknowledging something real beneath the games. Quiet sincerity.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、英語で母音の発音苦手だろ?
lines.en: You struggle with English vowel pronunciation, don't you?
lines.style: Gentle noticing. Not mocking—matter-of-fact. She's observed this about him. Quick pace, warm. The comfort of being seen by someone who doesn't make a thing of it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、自分のアイデンティティー悩んでんだろ?桜
lines.en: You worry about who you are, don't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Deeper now. The earlier teasing has given way to real attention. Slow enough to let the words land. No judgment—just recognizing something he carries. Steady.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家族で灯台のある岬行ったろ?
lines.en: Your family went to that cape with the lighthouse, right?
lines.style: Returning to lighter ground. Warm recall—she's thinking of a memory he shared. Curious but not intrusive. Genuine interest in the detail of his life.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ピンク色のシャツ買ったろ?桜
lines.en: You bought that pink shirt, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Closing the circle. Affectionate tease, but tender underneath. She's been paying attention all along. Close, intimate tone—the voice of someone who notices and keeps noticing.
